name: talence-platform
description: Invite-only Talence collection, deck, and device platform.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @talence/domain && npm run build --workspace @talence/ui && npm run build --workspace @talence/contracts && npm run build --workspace @talence/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:admin
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:python
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:admin
scripts.db:lint: npx supabase db lint --local --schema public,app_private,app_api --level warning --fail-on warning
scripts.ci: npm run canon:validate && npm run guard:architecture && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contracts && npm run lint:python && npm run format:python && npm run typecheck:python && npm run test:python && npm run build
